description: Bench's :check currently defaults to fn -> true end, so unchecked examples report correct: true while CONTEXT.md promises the catalog is 'checked for agreement'. Decision (grilling 2026-10-12): :check becomes required; opting out is explicit (check: :none, reason: "...") and prints correct: skipped (<reason>); run_all.exs lists every skipped entry. Bench stays off the two-modes machinery by design (baseline is never Elixir mode).
title: Defk.Bench.report: require :check or an explicit check: :none with reason
